title: Install the create-task program as an executable
notes:
installCreateTask writes ~/.claude/skills/create-task/create-task.js with no shebang and mode 0644, but claude-pr-loop runs PR_LOOP_CARD_SCRIPT as an executable, so pointing it at that file fails with "permission denied". Prepend "#!/usr/bin/env node" to the written program and write it with mode 0755 (keep the replaceFile atomic write and the rewrite-only-when-content-differs rule; a mode change alone must also be applied). Add a test that the installed file is executable and runs with --help or a no-board error. Open a PR, run /pr-loop, do not merge.

Shipped in PR #200: the installed create-task.js starts with #!/usr/bin/env node and is mode 0755 (replaceFile takes an optional mode, set with fchmod before the rename; a mode-only drift is chmodded, not rewritten). Test builds the real program, installs it into a temporary HOME and runs it as a command to the no-board refusal.
